original_test_intent: Manually verify each mapped cable adapter installs, seats, retains and removes without binding or damage.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Install/remove adapters in each approved slot and capture physical evidence.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Operator handles and judges every adapter/slot; software detection is supplemental.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: One physical fit check for every source-required slot.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Adapter/slot map, hot-plug/power/ESD method and fit criteria.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Enumeration does not prove mechanical fit or all-slot coverage.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Agent may prepare the slot checklist and collect post-action inventory only.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong hot-plug state or force can damage connectors.

no_automatic_retry: Do not force or repeat a failed insertion.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 already distinguished physical acceptance from optional automated evidence.
